rulings.verbatim: 也要放到工厂的dashboard里面，这是健康标准的一项，还要显示在总览里面。每个环节的健康标准都要添加。
rulings.intent: An open ready-for-agent issue whose units all ended moves on by itself, with no human step. Delivered (a merged unit): routed to triage; awaiting-release only for a PR verified merged into main, otherwise the next slice is cut. Closed by a stop-loss recut: restored once per unit. Never closed by the rule itself. Skipped: issues under a hold (.hold), issues at CONCLUDE_RUN_ATTEMPT_CAP, external deliverables. Head decision 2026-11-07 through the supervisor; the founder's order is the dashboard-health requirement quoted in verbatim.
